items.title: Review canonical source inventory
items.context: Confirm the plan identifies the current Proofbound milestone ledger and milestone_status implementation anchors and does not rely on retired-root stale planning prose.
items.userSees: A review note stating whether the implementation inventory is accurate and canonical.

happy.desc: The review confirms the canonical source files and docs for milestone ledger/status behavior.

edge.desc: The review identifies any retired-root or stale document that must not drive implementation truth.

adversarial.desc: The review does not treat future-plan prose as stronger than current code and accepted lifecycle facts.

verificationEvidence.note: Canonical inventory in the review doc matches current Proofbound anchors: proofstory handler for milestone_ledger_set/add/get, milestone-status handler/core for milestone_status and closeout, types, command policy, and ProofStory decision doc.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice session_brief && lattice aux_doc_list && rg -n milestone_ledger_set packages/main/src docs/requirements/decisions
verificationEvidence.note: Review used canonical /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound worktree, not retired Orchestrate, and aux_doc_list shows the new canonical review doc in docs/requirements/decisions.

Stale planning prose was not treated as stronger than current code; the review doc explicitly says this is not a from-scratch implementation plan and the implementation inventory is verified against source.

items.title: Review read-only status and write boundaries
items.context: Check milestone_status read-only argument gating, non-mutation behavior, and command-policy separation from milestone_ledger_set/add writes.
items.userSees: A review note stating whether status reporting and ledger writes are cleanly separated.

happy.desc: The review confirms milestone_status rejects mutation-like inputs and writes no workflow facts.

edge.desc: The review confirms missing-ledger status output remains diagnostic and does not repair storage.

adversarial.desc: The review finds no path where milestone_status creates, overwrites, or confirms milestone ledger facts.

verificationEvidence.note: milestone_status validates allowed args before store reads, returns READ_ONLY_MODE, and command policy classifies it as readOnly with no evidence, summary, reviewer, phase, DONE, or production side effects.

Live B-9051 milestone_status output has ledger.present=false, readOnly=true, runCommands=false, writeEvidence=false, advancePhase=false, launchReviewers=false, and a nextAction saying status will not create the ledger.
Dedicated milestone-status tests cover unknown and mutation-like flags, rejection before story reads, missing-ledger reporting without checklist reads, and no fabricated completion.

items.title: Review missing-ledger and schema adequacy
items.context: Check ordinary versus triggered missing-ledger behavior, candidate versus confirmed ledger semantics, schema fields, status values, checklist/verification bindings, and future grouped report support.
items.userSees: A review note stating whether missing-ledger policy and schema are sufficient or need a follow-up implementation story.

happy.desc: The review confirms missing-ledger behavior distinguishes optional ordinary stories from triggered or opt-in milestone work.

edge.desc: The review confirms candidate and confirmed milestone ledger semantics are clear enough for gates and reports.

adversarial.desc: The review identifies any schema path that could invent hidden sub-objectives or false precision from prose.

verificationEvidence.note: For this docs-only review story, ProofStory DEV gate passes after intent artifacts while milestone_status still reports ledger missing; ordinary non-ledger work is not retroactively blocked and status does not repair storage.

Command policy keeps milestone_ledger_set/add as PLAN-only gateEvidence candidate writes, and intent_collision pass is the confirmation boundary. B-9051 intent_collision reported Confirmed ledger hash: none, so no ledger was confirmed here.

Milestone schema and status rendering rely on explicit ledger fields, checklistRefs, verificationIntentRefs, requiredEvidence, parentLedgerId, and assignedStory; missing-ledger status says it cannot infer milestone progress from prose.

items.title: Review tests and agent capability claims
items.context: Check test coverage for read-only status, missing-ledger diagnostics, ledger writes, milestone-triggered gates, and no false DONE. Also check that the agent capability impact is specific and not overclaimed.
items.userSees: A review note stating whether negative controls and agent capability claims are adequate.

happy.desc: The review lists existing tests or concrete gaps for milestone status and ledger behavior.

edge.desc: The review explains how milestone ledgers improve agent progress, handoff, and stop conditions.

adversarial.desc: The review confirms the document does not claim milestone progress satisfies Story DONE, Authority DONE, or production readiness.

verificationEvidence.note: Build passes and the dedicated milestone-status suite passes, covering missing-ledger diagnostics, read-only mode, mutation-like flag rejection, closeout safety, and no fabricated completion.
The document states the capability impact as structured progress, safer execution admission, cleaner handoff, and less false DONE risk, which matches the source/test evidence.

The document explicitly says milestone completion stays distinct from lifecycle DONE and that the capability is not agents declaring themselves done; closeout code also refuses to fabricate success without a ledger.
